notes: Widget Cards editor cleaned up and trimmed: for every user, hid background Gradient/Image modes, border Sides/Style(non-solid)/Mode(gradient), angled corners, the whole Shadow/Depth section, and the redundant Typography link (already on…

Nothing was removed from the data model or the card-paint code — a panel that already had one of those set keeps rendering it exactly as before; only the editor controls for setting them are gone. Documented the full available-vs-exposed…

Section headers moved off inline raw-pixel/raw-color styling onto a real CSS class using design-system tokens, so spacing between Background/Border/Corners is now identical and consistent instead of copy-pasted per section.

Deleted ~180 lines of now-unreachable editor code (gradient-stop-list builders, the 4-effect shadow/glow list) that only existed to serve the controls just hidden — confirmed via grep nothing else in the app called them.
